correctness.rationale: A shattered support must be a partial off-diagonal matching, by the full-positive trace. Both complete finite enumerations check every such support of sizes zero through five against all 130 sign-even derangements; no five-cell support shatters, excluding larger supports by heredity. Independently implemented row-column and recursive-rook enumerators give the same face counts and facets. Cycle-sign and inversion-sign tests agree. Explicit GF(2) boundary reductions produce ranks 1,29,286,750; face counts imply Betti ranks 384 and 390. The orbit enumeration traverses all 720 relabelings and checks disjoint orbit cover. No infinite theorem is asserted.

value.rationale: Parity-restricted derangements are a canonical, intrinsically motivated sign-conditioned perfect-matching system, rather than an ad hoc subset. Against the all-derangement baseline, 1575 shattered quadruples disappear but 360 maximal triples persist, producing a nonpure complex. The complete orbit census and two distinct nonzero mod-two Betti dimensions are substantive geometric invariants not implied by the shared VC dimension 4. This is a natural complete finite classification with a clear structural parity boundary.
